title: Classic POLYLINE and VERTEX DXF topology-role closure
scope: Make typed POLYLINE output keep the parent topology, child VERTEX role bits, and child subclass markers consistent.

formatEvidence.observation: Autodesk assigns VERTEX group-70 bits 32, 64, and 128 to 3D-polyline, polygon-mesh, and polyface roles, respectively; polyface coordinates use 64+128 while face records use 128 without 64. POLYLINE group 70 identifies the parent topology.
formatEvidence.implementationInference: The parent record supplies a role for child vertices. Missing 3D-polyline or polygon-mesh role bits can be restored from that parent; conflicting child role bits and mutually conflicting parent topology bits are refused.

implementation.behavior: validateVertexTypesDxf rejects conflicting parent topology bits and child VERTEX roles. Typed output adds the expected role bit for 3D-polyline and polygon-mesh vertices when absent, then writes the matching type-specific subclass. Existing polyface coordinate/face checks remain in force.
implementation.inputPolicy: Tolerant DXF parsing is unchanged; the role gate applies to typed output and compound write admission.

assertions: a 3D-polyline vertex incorrectly marked as polygon mesh refuses atomically
corrected children retry on the same adapter and receive group-70 bit 32
raw output pairs bit 32 with AcDb3dPolylineVertex
typed readback preserves WCS vertices and the canonical role
conflicting 3D-polyline and polygon-mesh parent bits refuse with destination preservation
restoring the valid parent topology retries on the same adapter
control.fixturePolicy: The controls author all model records in test code and write temporary outputs; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limitations: No physical producer or native consumer semantics are established.
This generated role-closure control does not establish general 3D polyline, polygon-mesh, or polyface support.
